analyst_view.overall: Early view: Braga (17th, four points) are eighth in Portugal with only 13 goals in 11 league games, and their European games have been tight: a 3-0 defeat in Copenhagen, a 2-0 win over Gent and a 0-0 at AGF. KuPS (33rd, one point) lost 4-2 to Trabzonspor and 2-0 at Borac before a 0-0 with Gent. Braga are clear favourites; how much they score is the question.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.6 goals, 2.1 for Braga. I lean a little lower: Braga's league games have averaged just over two goals in total, they drew 0-0 at AGF last time out, and KuPS have scored once in their last two European games. A 1-0 or 2-0 home win fits this better than an open game.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.6 corners, 7.1 for Braga. Braga at home should dominate the ball against a KuPS side that kept Gent out last time, which the split already reflects.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.0 cards. Nothing in either side's European games points to a disciplinary trend, and no referee is known, so I stay with the number.

shots.text: The numbers say 29.8 shots, 23.3 for Braga. I lean lower: Braga's low scoring at home and in the league suggests they do not produce shots in bulk, and a deep KuPS block should limit good chances.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.1 shots on target. I lean slightly lower for the same reasons: Braga have scored two goals in their last two European games and KuPS rarely test keepers.
